== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Skysworn]] armor is a specialized set of green Jade{{!}}jade-colored protective gear worn by members of the [[Skysworn]], an elite group of [[sacred artists]] in the [[Blackflame Empire]] dedicated to upholding law and justice. These suits are highly respected uniforms that grant their wearers the ability to fly. The armor is equipped with various advanced defensive [[constructs]], such as a [[wind]] barrier for emergency protection, protective [[scripts]] around the neck and head, and a dream [[construct]] capable of transmitting messages. Some versions also include a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] for mobility. While highly effective at defending against spiritual and physical attacks, the armor requires significant maintenance and power; [[constructs]] must be fueled by compatible [[madra]] or they will eventually deplete. The armor's weaponry is uniquely keyed to specific individuals or the [[Skysworn]] organization itself, allowing for remote deactivation or tracking. The specialized [[Soulsmith foundries]] within the [[Skysworn headquarters]], [[Starsweep Tower]], are capable of producing high-level [[constructs]], including those for [[Underlord|Underlords]].}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Worn by both [[Yerin]] and [[Lindon]], the [[Skysworn]] armor features defensive [[constructs]] for the head and a triggered [[wind]] barrier. These suits can generate an emerald green cloud and may include [[dream constructs]] for the transmission of messages. While officials wearing the armor are granted easy passage through air traffic, [[Lindon]] eventually finds his own suit cracked and plans to use a [[void key]] to retrieve it. Meanwhile, [[Mercy]] has opted to remove her [[Skysworn]] armor.}}
